cover_letter:
Dear Bieke,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales Support Officer Benelux position at Edgard & Cooper. Your mission to feed pets well while caring for the planet, and your B Corp status, immediately caught my attention. I'm excited by the opportunity to bring order to a busy sales team and help turn plans into action.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage multiple client websites, ensuring content is accurate and up to date. I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and CMS updates, often juggling priorities and solving operational hiccups. This experience has honed my ability to keep details right and processes flowing smoothly. Previously, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building digital workplace sites for large retail and logistics clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. This gave me insight into the retail environment and the importance of clear communication and coordination across departments.

I'm confident with sales data and KPIs, using tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance and flag gaps. I'm also proactive in finding smarter ways to automate recurring tasks, having used Python and AI tools to streamline workflows. While my Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, I'm fluent in English and committed to improving my Dutch further.

I thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy building strong relationships with customers and colleagues. I'm organised, detail-focused, and practical in juggling priorities. I'd love to bring my skills to Edgard & Cooper and support your Sales and Field Sales teams across Belgium and the Netherlands.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your pack.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
